UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Shared GoGo Account user profile stored under users/{uid}

photoURL.description: Optional profile avatar URL (empty string or valid http/https URL up to 2048 chars)

authProvider.description: Authentication provider used by the user

marketingSubscribed.description: Whether the user has currently opted in to optional GoGo marketing emails

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the GoGo account was created (immutable)

lastLoginAt.description: Server timestamp when the user last signed in or synced profile

MarketingSubscriber.title: MarketingSubscriber
MarketingSubscriber.description: Explicit marketing consent and subscription record stored under marketingSubscribers/{uid}

subscribed.description: True only when the user explicitly opted in and has not unsubscribed

consentTimestamp.description: Server timestamp when explicit marketing consent was granted (or null if never consented)

consentVersion.description: Version identifier of the marketing consent text shown to the user

consentText.description: Exact marketing consent statement accepted by the user

source.description: Origin surface where the record was created or updated (e.g. registration_form, account_profile, unsubscribe_page)

registeredAt.description: Server timestamp when the user registered (immutable)

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the subscription record was last updated

unsubscribedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user unsubscribed (or null if active/never subscribed)

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Authorized GoGo Administrator record stored under admins/{uid}

createdAt.description: Timestamp when admin record was created

GameSaveProfile.title: GameSaveProfile
GameSaveProfile.description: Per-game cloud save document stored under gameProfiles/{uid}/games/{gameId}

gameId.description: Supported GoGo game identifier matching the document ID

progress.description: Validated game save payload containing stage/level progress, stars, streaks, and clientUpdatedAtMs

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud save was written

/users/{uid}.description: User account profile document accessible by the authenticated owner {uid} or an authorized GoGo Administrator

/marketingSubscribers/{uid}.description: Marketing subscription and consent audit record accessible only by the authenticated owner {uid} or an authorized GoGo Administrator

/admins/{uid}.description: Administrator role lookup collection readable by the authenticated owner or admin

/gameProfiles/{uid}/games/{gameId}.description: Private per-game cloud save document accessible only by the authenticated owner {uid} for supported games (arrowout, crystalquest)
